A phone app's motion is a table in the reference now, the same numbers for every app: cards fly in from both sides on every tab and every return to it, a flung page runs past its edge and springs back, and a press gives way under the finger. The coffee and PayPal buttons on the About card open windows in which the donor pays without leaving the app, and PayPal takes monthly and yearly giving too. The App tab is one standard: every other way to get the app as a tile of one shape, only the forms this instance is not, listings that are coming marked as coming, and the APK with a Download button and a code to scan. In round everything somebody presses is a true pill, soft is the default shape, and a fourth shape hides behind square.

**Adopting apps with a phone app:** copy `reference/motionNative.ts` as it is and read the level's numbers from `NATIVE_MOTION` instead of a table of your own. Give every tab the arrival line, lists included, and follow "On a phone" under "The motion engine" for the rest: the late-mount rule for rows a list mounts while scrolling, the start for a page that mounts after its tab was focused, and the edge spring with the platform's own overscroll switched off where `edge` is not 0.

**Adopting apps:** copy `reference/paypal.ts`, `reference/react/CoffeeDialog.tsx`, `reference/react/PaypalDialog.tsx` and `reference/react/usePaypalButtons.ts`. `AboutCard` takes `onCoffee` and `onPaypal` in place of `coffeeUrl` and `paypalUrl`. Pass the app's horizontal selector to `PaypalDialog` as `renderSelector`. Allow `https://www.paypal.com`, `https://*.paypal.com` and `https://*.paypalobjects.com` for scripts, frames and connections, and `https://buymeacoffee.com` for frames, wherever the app sends a Content-Security-Policy.

**Adopting apps with an App tab or a shape picker:** copy `reference/react/AppTile.tsx` and `reference/appMarks.ts`, and the `--brand-android`, `--brand-docker` and `--brand-unraid-*` pairs from all three theme blocks of `reference/tokens.css` together with the `.glim-android-mark`, `.glim-docker-mark` and `.glim-unraid-mark` rules. For the shapes, copy the `:root` and `leaf` blocks of `reference/tokens.css` and `SHAPES_STORED`, `DEFAULT_SHAPE` and `leafTap()` from `reference/appearance.ts`, point buttons, tabs, badges, selector segments and switches at `--radius-pill` instead of `--radius-control`, and call soft "Abgerundet" in German. Build the App tab as "The App tab" in design-language.md describes: the phone card where there is a phone app, and a second card with the desktop app in a container or a server install in the desktop app. An app with only one form gets no App tab. A desktop build passes its shell's browser opener to the tiles as `onLinkClick` and to `AboutCard` as `openUrl`; where the shell opens no popups, as Wails does on macOS and Linux, the About card's PayPal button opens the donation page in the browser.

## ✨ Added

- **`reference/motionNative.ts`**, the phone's motion levels as numbers with no React Native import: layout and fade durations, the spring's damping, and the arrival, press and edge dials. `springOf()`, `arrivalDelay()`, `arrivalSide()` and `edgeReach()` turn them into what `Animated` takes. ArrowLoop's app is the first to run on it.
- **The edge spring.** At `wild` a page flung against its top or bottom runs on up to 36 points past it and swings back, at `storm` up to 64, and a faster fling runs further. The lower levels keep Android's own overscroll effect.
- **`reference/react/CoffeeDialog.tsx`**, Buy Me a Coffee's widget inside a house window. The widget page is the one BMAC page that may be framed, and the amount, name, message and card payment all happen in it.
- **`reference/react/PaypalDialog.tsx`**, **`reference/react/usePaypalButtons.ts`** and **`reference/paypal.ts`**: once, monthly or yearly and the amount as house selectors, the free amount to the right of the presets, and under them PayPal's wallet button and its card button, which opens a card form in the window for somebody without a PayPal account.
- **`reference/react/AppTile.tsx`**, the tile for one way to get the app: a link to a file or a listing, a button that does something on the page, or a quiet tile with a "Soon" badge while its listing does not exist. `face` lets a tile show something else, such as the code to scan on the APK tile.
- **`reference/appMarks.ts`**: Google Play, Android, Docker, Unraid, the ZIP, Windows, Apple and Linux as markup with prefixed ids.
- **`leaf`, a hidden fourth shape**: two opposite corners rounded, the other two sharp. Set the shape to square and tap square five more times; `leafTap()` counts, and `SHAPES_STORED` keeps a found leaf across a reload. It is plain per-corner radii, so it looks the same in every browser, desktop shell and phone app.
- **Three colour pairs for single-colour marks.** Android's green, Docker's blue and Unraid's red gradient each take a deeper value while their tile is lit, since the hover grey carries none of them, and a single deep value on the light theme.

## 🎨 Design

- **Every tab arrives.** A list is held to the same arrival as a page, since a level that animates some tabs and not others looks broken. Rows a list mounts while somebody scrolls appear without flying in, because the person scrolled to them.
- **A page that mounts after its tab was focused starts its arrival at once** instead of waiting for a focus event that has already fired, which left its cards invisible.
- **Giving happens in the app.** Coffee and PayPal open windows like the crypto one instead of a browser tab. Nothing from either provider loads before its window opens.
- **Recurring giving through one plan per interval.** Each plan costs 1 EUR a unit and the amount is the quantity, so monthly and yearly giving work for any whole amount. Every PayPal funding source but the wallet and the card is off.
- **Round has true pills.** Buttons, tabs, badges, selector segments and switches read `--radius-pill`, so in round they are pills and circles. Cards go from 16 to 20px, fields and panels from 10 to 12px. Soft and square look as they did, because their pill and control radii were already the same.
- **Soft is the default shape.** A stored choice keeps its shape and a fresh install starts on soft. The German name is Abgerundet.
- **"The App tab"** in design-language.md: one tile shape for every way, only the forms this instance is not, only the ways that exist, a coming listing shown as coming, the APK's Download and QR code buttons with a code that fills the tile, a Docker tile that copies its command, the source archive named "Source code.zip", and the version in the phone card's corner. ArrowLoop's App tab is the first to follow it.
- **A desktop app's links leave through its shell.** `AppTile` takes `onLinkClick` and `AboutCard` takes `openUrl`, so a desktop build can hand every external link to the system browser. Where the shell opens no popups, the PayPal button opens the donation page there too.
